name: Temple Retrieval - Ahmedabad
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE (toLower(s.district) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad' OR toLower(s.state) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad' OR toLower(s.address) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad') AND (toLower(st.type) CONTAINS 'temple' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'temple') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Temple Retrieval - Junagadh
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE (toLower(s.district) CONTAINS 'junagadh' OR toLower(s.state) CONTAINS 'junagadh' OR toLower(s.address) CONTAINS 'junagadh') AND (toLower(st.type) CONTAINS 'temple' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'temple') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Mosques in Ahmedabad
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE (toLower(s.district) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad' OR toLower(s.state) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad' OR toLower(s.address) CONTAINS 'ahmedabad') AND (toLower(st.type) CONTAINS 'mosque' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'mosque') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Stepwells in Gujarat
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE toLower(s.state) CONTAINS 'gujarat' AND (toLower(st.type) CONTAINS 'stepwell' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'stepwell') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: All Inscriptions
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_ARTIFACT]->(a:Artifact) WHERE toLower(a.type) CONTAINS 'inscription' RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: All Memorial Stones
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_ARTIFACT]->(a:Artifact) WHERE toLower(a.type) CONTAINS 'memorial' RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Stone Inscription at Masjid
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_ARTIFACT]->(a:Artifact) WHERE (toLower(st.type) CONTAINS 'mosque' OR toLower(st.name) CONTAINS 'masjid') AND toLower(a.type) CONTAINS 'inscription' RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Structures in Jumma Masjid
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'jumma masjid' RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name

name: Negative Query
neo4j_query: MATCH (s:Site)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(st:Structure) WHERE toLower(s.district) CONTAINS 'unknown place' RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS site_name
